newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka says forex reserves at $2.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka says forex reserves at $2.5 bln.

text.p: Sri Lankan Deputy Finance Minister G.L. Peiris said on Wednesday the country had foreign exchange reserves of $2.5 billion, enough for roughly five months of imports.
"This is very good for a developing country," Peiris told parliament as he presented the state budget for calendar 1997.

"We have set aside only 12 percent of the country's foreign revenue from tea and rubber exports and remittances from workers abroad for debt servicing, an achievement any third world country can be proud of," he said.
